facts.text: The Bahamas is an Atlantic archipelago near Florida.
Nassau is on the island of New Providence.
Mount Alvernia, the country’s highest point, is on Cat Island.

culture.text: Junkanoo street celebrations combine elaborate costumes, brass instruments, cowbells, and African rhythms.

food.name: Cracked conch
food.text: Conch, a marine mollusk, is served deep-fried in this island dish.
